        "sold_today": {good: t["sold"] for good, t in trades.items()},
        "bought_today": {good: t["bought"] for good, t in trades.items()},

    )


def witnesses_of(who):
    """The game decides who actually had line of sight."""
    return ["GARETH", "OLD_MARC"]


def other_guards(who):
    """Every guard except the one who saw it."""
    return [g for g in GUARDS if g != who]


def announce(name, line):
    """The game's own way of putting a line on screen."""
    print(f"{name}: {line}")

    kl.event(
        f"the player stole the {what} at the {where}",
        by=PLAYER,
        seen_by=seen_by,
        tag="theft",
        impact=-0.6,
    )

    for guard in seen_by:
        announce(guard, kl.say(guard, "witnessed_theft",
                               {"who": PLAYER, "what": what, "where": where}))

        # 3. pass it on: each witness tells the guards who did not see it
        for other in other_guards(guard):
            kl.meet(guard, other)
            if kl.knows(other, "theft"):
                announce(other, kl.say(other, "heard_theft",
                                       {"who": PLAYER, "what": what, "where": where}))
